WITH ranked_data AS (
  SELECT 
    t3.previouspermitnumber,
    t3.sidewalkshortdesc,
    t3.permitnumberofzones,
    t5.boroughname,
    t5.permitlocationcomments,
    t5.permithousenumber,
    t5.permitlinearfeet,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY t5.boroughname 
      ORDER BY t3.permitnumberofzones DESC
    ) AS row_num
  FROM `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_1` t1
  INNER JOIN `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_2` t2 ON t1.permitnumber = t2.permitnumber
  INNER JOIN `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_3` t3 ON t1.createdon = t3.createdon
  INNER JOIN `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_4` t4 ON t2.permitissuedate = t4.permitissuedate
  INNER JOIN `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_5` t5 ON t4.applicationtrackingid = t5.applicationtrackingid 
  WHERE t5.boroughname IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  previouspermitnumber,
  sidewalkshortdesc,
  permitnumberofzones,
  boroughname,
  permitlocationcomments,
  permithousenumber,
  permitlinearfeet
FROM ranked_data
WHERE row_num <= 5

SELECT t5.boroughname, t5.permittypedesc, SUM(t5.permitlinearfeet) AS total, AVG(t5.permitlinearfeet) AS average, COUNT(*) AS count FROM `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_1` t1
INNER JOIN `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_2` t2 ON t1.permitnumber = t2.permitnumber
INNER JOIN `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_3` t3 ON t1.createdon = t3.createdon
INNER JOIN `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_4` t4 ON t2.permitissuedate = t4.permitissuedate
INNER JOIN `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_5` t5 ON t4.applicationtrackingid = t5.applicationtrackingid GROUP BY t5.boroughname, t5.permittypedesc

WITH categorized_data AS (
  SELECT t1.createdon, t1.permitseriesshortdesc, t3.createdon, t3.permitnumberofzones, t5.boroughname, t5.permitlinearfeet,
         CASE
           WHEN t5.permitlinearfeet > 500 THEN 'large'
           WHEN t5.permitlinearfeet > 100 THEN 'medium'
           ELSE 'small'
         END AS category
  FROM `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_1` t1
  INNER JOIN `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_2` t2 ON t1.permitnumber = t2.permitnumber
  INNER JOIN `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_3` t3 ON t1.createdon = t3.createdon
  INNER JOIN `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_4` t4 ON t2.permitissuedate = t4.permitissuedate
  INNER JOIN `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_5` t5 ON t4.applicationtrackingid = t5.applicationtrackingid
  WHERE t5.permitlinearfeet IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT createdon, permitseriesshortdesc, boroughname, category,
       COUNT(*) AS count,
       AVG(permitlinearfeet) AS avg_value,
       SUM(permitlinearfeet) AS total_value,
       MAX(permitlinearfeet) AS max_value
FROM categorized_data
GROUP BY createdon, permitseriesshortdesc, boroughname, category

SELECT t1.createdon, t1.permitseriesshortdesc, t1.applicationtypeshortdesc, t3.createdon, SUM(t3.permitnumberofzones) AS total_zones FROM `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_1` t1
INNER JOIN `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_2` t2 ON t1.permitnumber = t2.permitnumber
INNER JOIN `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_3` t3 ON t1.createdon = t3.createdon
INNER JOIN `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_4` t4 ON t2.permitissuedate = t4.permitissuedate
INNER JOIN `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_5` t5 ON t4.applicationtrackingid = t5.applicationtrackingid GROUP BY t1.createdon, t1.permitseriesshortdesc, t1.applicationtypeshortdesc, t3.createdon

WITH base_data AS (SELECT t2.permitteename, t2.permitstatusshortdesc, t3.permitnumberofzones, t3.previouspermitnumber, t5.boroughname, t5.permitlinearfeet FROM `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_1` t1
INNER JOIN `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_2` t2 ON t1.permitnumber = t2.permitnumber
INNER JOIN `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_3` t3 ON t1.createdon = t3.createdon
INNER JOIN `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_4` t4 ON t2.permitissuedate = t4.permitissuedate
INNER JOIN `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_5` t5 ON t4.applicationtrackingid = t5.applicationtrackingid WHERE t5.permitlinearfeet IS NOT NULL), aggregated AS (SELECT boroughname, permitstatusshortdesc, SUM(permitlinearfeet) as total, COUNT(*) as count, AVG(permitlinearfeet) as average FROM base_data GROUP BY boroughname, permitstatusshortdesc) SELECT boroughname, permitstatusshortdesc, total, count, average FROM aggregated WHERE count > 5 ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT t2.permitstatusshortdesc AS permit_status, SUM(t3.permitnumberofzones) AS total_dimension1, AVG(t5.permitlinearfeet) AS average_dimension2 FROM `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_1` t1
INNER JOIN `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_2` t2 ON t1.permitnumber = t2.permitnumber
INNER JOIN `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_3` t3 ON t1.createdon = t3.createdon
INNER JOIN `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_4` t4 ON t2.permitissuedate = t4.permitissuedate
INNER JOIN `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_5` t5 ON t4.applicationtrackingid = t5.applicationtrackingid GROUP BY t2.permitstatusshortdesc

WITH base_data AS (SELECT t1.permitnumber, t1.createdon, t1.permitseriesshortdesc, t2.permitnumber AS t2_permitnumber, t2.permitissuedate, t2.permitteename, t3.createdon AS t3_createdon, t3.permitnumberofzones, t5.permitlinearfeet FROM `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_1` t1
INNER JOIN `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_2` t2 ON t1.permitnumber = t2.permitnumber
INNER JOIN `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_3` t3 ON t1.createdon = t3.createdon
INNER JOIN `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_4` t4 ON t2.permitissuedate = t4.permitissuedate
INNER JOIN `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_5` t5 ON t4.applicationtrackingid = t5.applicationtrackingid WHERE t2.permitstatusshortdesc = 'EXPIRED') SELECT permitseriesshortdesc, permitissuedate, permitteename, createdon, permitnumber, t3_createdon, t2_permitnumber, COUNT(*) as record_count, SUM(permitlinearfeet) as total_amount, AVG(permitlinearfeet) as avg_amount, MAX(permitlinearfeet) as max_amount, MIN(permitlinearfeet) as min_amount FROM base_data GROUP BY permitseriesshortdesc, permitissuedate, permitteename, createdon, permitnumber, t3_createdon, t2_permitnumber HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5

SELECT t5.boroughname, SUM(t5.permitlinearfeet) AS total_permitlinearfeet FROM `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_1` t1
INNER JOIN `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_2` t2 ON t1.permitnumber = t2.permitnumber
INNER JOIN `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_3` t3 ON t1.createdon = t3.createdon
INNER JOIN `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_4` t4 ON t2.permitissuedate = t4.permitissuedate
INNER JOIN `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_5` t5 ON t4.applicationtrackingid = t5.applicationtrackingid GROUP BY t5.boroughname

WITH ranked AS (SELECT t3.previouspermitnumber, t3.sidewalkshortdesc, t4.applicationtrackingid, t4.permittotalsqfeet, t5.applicationtrackingid, t5.boroughname, t5.permittypedesc, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t5.boroughname ORDER BY t4.permittotalsqfeet DESC) as rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t5.permittypedesc ORDER BY t4.permittotalsqfeet) as dense_rank FROM `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_1` t1
INNER JOIN `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_2` t2 ON t1.permitnumber = t2.permitnumber
INNER JOIN `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_3` t3 ON t1.createdon = t3.createdon
INNER JOIN `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_4` t4 ON t2.permitissuedate = t4.permitissuedate
INNER JOIN `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_5` t5 ON t4.applicationtrackingid = t5.applicationtrackingid) SELECT previouspermitnumber, sidewalkshortdesc, applicationtrackingid, permittotalsqfeet, boroughname, permittypedesc, rank, dense_rank FROM ranked WHERE rank <= 5

SELECT t5.boroughname, t4.applicationtrackingid, t5.applicationtrackingid, t4.pavementshortdesc, SUM(t4.permittotalsqfeet) AS total_permit_area FROM `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_1` t1
INNER JOIN `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_2` t2 ON t1.permitnumber = t2.permitnumber
INNER JOIN `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_3` t3 ON t1.createdon = t3.createdon
INNER JOIN `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_4` t4 ON t2.permitissuedate = t4.permitissuedate
INNER JOIN `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_5` t5 ON t4.applicationtrackingid = t5.applicationtrackingid GROUP BY t5.boroughname, t4.applicationtrackingid, t5.applicationtrackingid, t4.pavementshortdesc

WITH ranked_data AS (SELECT t1.createdon, t1.permitseriesshortdesc, t3.createdon AS t3_createdon, t3.permitnumberofzones, t4.applicationtrackingid, t4.permittotalsqfeet, t5.applicationtrackingid AS t5_applicationtrackingid, t5.boroughname, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t5.boroughname ORDER BY t4.permittotalsqfeet DESC) as row_num FROM `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_1` t1
INNER JOIN `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_2` t2 ON t1.permitnumber = t2.permitnumber
INNER JOIN `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_3` t3 ON t1.createdon = t3.createdon
INNER JOIN `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_4` t4 ON t2.permitissuedate = t4.permitissuedate
INNER JOIN `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_5` t5 ON t4.applicationtrackingid = t5.applicationtrackingid WHERE t4.permittotalsqfeet IS NOT NULL) SELECT createdon, permitseriesshortdesc, t3_createdon, permitnumberofzones, applicationtrackingid, permittotalsqfeet, t5_applicationtrackingid, boroughname FROM ranked_data WHERE row_num <= 3

SELECT t4.applicationtrackingid, SUM(t4.permittotalsqfeet) AS total_permit_sqft, t5.boroughname, t3.permitnumberofzones FROM `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_1` t1
INNER JOIN `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_2` t2 ON t1.permitnumber = t2.permitnumber
INNER JOIN `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_3` t3 ON t1.createdon = t3.createdon
INNER JOIN `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_4` t4 ON t2.permitissuedate = t4.permitissuedate
INNER JOIN `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_5` t5 ON t4.applicationtrackingid = t5.applicationtrackingid GROUP BY t4.applicationtrackingid, t5.boroughname, t3.permitnumberofzones

WITH categorized_data AS (
  SELECT 
    t4.permitissuedate,
    t4.applicationtrackingid,
    t2.permitissuedate AS t2_permitissuedate,
    t5.applicationtrackingid AS t5_applicationtrackingid,
    t3.permitnumberofzones,
    t5.permitlinearfeet,
    t5.boroughname,
    CASE 
      WHEN t5.permitlinearfeet > 500 THEN 'Large'
      WHEN t5.permitlinearfeet > 100 THEN 'Medium'
      ELSE 'Small'
    END AS category
  FROM `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_1` t1
  INNER JOIN `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_2` t2 ON t1.permitnumber = t2.permitnumber
  INNER JOIN `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_3` t3 ON t1.createdon = t3.createdon
  INNER JOIN `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_4` t4 ON t2.permitissuedate = t4.permitissuedate
  INNER JOIN `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_5` t5 ON t4.applicationtrackingid = t5.applicationtrackingid
  WHERE t5.boroughname IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  boroughname,
  category,
  COUNT(*) AS count,
  AVG(permitlinearfeet) AS avg_value,
  SUM(permitlinearfeet) AS total_value,
  MAX(permitlinearfeet) AS max_value
FROM categorized_data
GROUP BY boroughname, category

SELECT t4.permitissuedate, COUNT(t4.applicationtrackingid) AS permit_count, t2.permitstatusshortdesc, t3.permitnumberofzones, t4.pavementshortdesc, t5.boroughname FROM `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_1` t1
INNER JOIN `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_2` t2 ON t1.permitnumber = t2.permitnumber
INNER JOIN `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_3` t3 ON t1.createdon = t3.createdon
INNER JOIN `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_4` t4 ON t2.permitissuedate = t4.permitissuedate
INNER JOIN `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_5` t5 ON t4.applicationtrackingid = t5.applicationtrackingid GROUP BY t4.permitissuedate, t2.permitstatusshortdesc, t3.permitnumberofzones, t4.pavementshortdesc, t5.boroughname

WITH base_data AS (
  SELECT 
    t1.permitnumber,
    t1.createdon,
    t1.permitseriesshortdesc,
    t2.permitnumber AS t2_permitnumber,
    t2.permitissuedate,
    t3.createdon AS t3_createdon,
    t3.permitnumberofzones,
    t4.permitissuedate AS t4_permitissuedate,
    t4.applicationtrackingid,
    t5.applicationtrackingid AS t5_applicationtrackingid,
    t5.boroughname
  FROM `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_1` t1
  INNER JOIN `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_2` t2 ON t1.permitnumber = t2.permitnumber
  INNER JOIN `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_3` t3 ON t1.createdon = t3.createdon
  INNER JOIN `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_4` t4 ON t2.permitissuedate = t4.permitissuedate
  INNER JOIN `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_5` t5 ON t4.applicationtrackingid = t5.applicationtrackingid
  WHERE t2.permitissuedate >= '2022-01-01'
), 
aggregated AS (
  SELECT 
    boroughname,
    permitseriesshortdesc,
    t2_permitnumber,
    permitissuedate,
    applicationtrackingid,
    SUM(permitnumberofzones) AS total,
    COUNT(*) AS count,
    AVG(permitnumberofzones) AS average
  FROM base_data
  GROUP BY boroughname, permitseriesshortdesc, t2_permitnumber, permitissuedate, applicationtrackingid
)
SELECT 
  boroughname,
  permitseriesshortdesc,
  t2_permitnumber,
  permitissuedate,
  applicationtrackingid,
  total,
  count,
  average
FROM aggregated
WHERE boroughname IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY total DESC
LIMIT 100

SELECT t4.applicationtrackingid, SUM(t4.permittotalsqfeet) AS total_permit_area, t1.permitseriesshortdesc, t5.boroughname, t2.permitissuedate FROM `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_1` t1
INNER JOIN `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_2` t2 ON t1.permitnumber = t2.permitnumber
INNER JOIN `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_3` t3 ON t1.createdon = t3.createdon
INNER JOIN `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_4` t4 ON t2.permitissuedate = t4.permitissuedate
INNER JOIN `Street Construction Permits (2022-Present)_5` t5 ON t4.applicationtrackingid = t5.applicationtrackingid GROUP BY t4.applicationtrackingid, t1.permitseriesshortdesc, t5.boroughname, t2.permitissuedate

WITH categorized_data AS (SELECT t3.city, t4.tablet_status, t5.generated_on, t5.wifi_status_date, t6.corner, t6.boro, CASE WHEN t5.generated_on > '2023-04-17 12:00:00' THEN 'recent' WHEN t5.generated_on > '2023-04-16 12:00:00' THEN 'moderate' ELSE 'old' END as category FROM `LinkNYC Kiosk Status (Historical)_linknyc_kiosk_status_history` t1
INNER JOIN `LinkNYC Kiosk Status (Historical)_linknyc_kiosk_locations_2` t2 ON t1.unique_id = t2.unique_id
INNER JOIN `LinkNYC Kiosk Status (Historical)_linknyc_kiosk_locations_1` t3 ON t1.site_id = t3.site_id
INNER JOIN `node_4` t4 ON t1.ppt_id = t4.ppt_id
INNER JOIN `LinkNYC Kiosk Status (Historical)_linknyc_kiosk_status_history_1` t5 ON t2.latitude = t5.latitude AND t2.longitude = t5.longitude
INNER JOIN `LinkNYC Kiosk Status (Historical)_linknyc_kiosk_locations` t6 ON t2.address = t6.address WHERE t4.tablet_status = 'up') SELECT city, tablet_status, generated_on, corner, boro, category, COUNT(*) as count, AVG(NULL) as avg_value, SUM(NULL) as total_value, MAX(NULL) as max_value FROM categorized_data GROUP BY city, tablet_status, generated_on, corner, boro, category

SELECT t3.city AS group_column1, t4.tablet_status AS group_column2, SUM(LENGTH(t6.corner)) AS total, AVG(LENGTH(t6.corner)) AS average, COUNT(*) AS count FROM `LinkNYC Kiosk Status (Historical)_linknyc_kiosk_status_history` t1
INNER JOIN `LinkNYC Kiosk Status (Historical)_linknyc_kiosk_locations_2` t2 ON t1.unique_id = t2.unique_id
INNER JOIN `LinkNYC Kiosk Status (Historical)_linknyc_kiosk_locations_1` t3 ON t1.site_id = t3.site_id
INNER JOIN `node_4` t4 ON t1.ppt_id = t4.ppt_id
INNER JOIN `LinkNYC Kiosk Status (Historical)_linknyc_kiosk_status_history_1` t5 ON t2.latitude = t5.latitude AND t2.longitude = t5.longitude
INNER JOIN `LinkNYC Kiosk Status (Historical)_linknyc_kiosk_locations` t6 ON t2.address = t6.address GROUP BY t3.city, t4.tablet_status

WITH base_data AS (
  SELECT 
    t1.site_id,
    t1.ppt_id,
    t1.wifi_status,
    t3.site_id AS t3_site_id,
    t3.city,
    t4.ppt_id AS t4_ppt_id,
    t4.tablet_status,
    t5.generated_on,
    t6.corner
  FROM `LinkNYC Kiosk Status (Historical)_linknyc_kiosk_status_history` t1
  INNER JOIN `LinkNYC Kiosk Status (Historical)_linknyc_kiosk_locations_2` t2 ON t1.unique_id = t2.unique_id
  INNER JOIN `LinkNYC Kiosk Status (Historical)_linknyc_kiosk_locations_1` t3 ON t1.site_id = t3.site_id
  INNER JOIN `node_4` t4 ON t1.ppt_id = t4.ppt_id
  INNER JOIN `LinkNYC Kiosk Status (Historical)_linknyc_kiosk_status_history_1` t5 ON t2.latitude = t5.latitude AND t2.longitude = t5.longitude
  INNER JOIN `LinkNYC Kiosk Status (Historical)_linknyc_kiosk_locations` t6 ON t2.address = t6.address 
  WHERE t1.wifi_status = 'up'
), 
aggregated AS (
  SELECT 
    city,
    wifi_status,
    corner,
    COUNT(*) as total,
    COUNT(*) as count,
    AVG(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY city, wifi_status, corner) as average
  FROM base_data
  GROUP BY city, wifi_status, corner
)
SELECT 
  city,
  wifi_status,
  corner,
  total,
  count,
  average
FROM aggregated 
WHERE total > 1
ORDER BY total DESC 
LIMIT 100

SELECT t2.phone_status_date AS fact_column, SUM(1) AS total_dimension1, AVG(1) AS average_dimension2, t2.latitude, t2.longitude, t2.address, t5.latitude AS status_latitude, t5.longitude AS status_longitude, t6.address AS location_address FROM `LinkNYC Kiosk Status (Historical)_linknyc_kiosk_status_history` t1
INNER JOIN `LinkNYC Kiosk Status (Historical)_linknyc_kiosk_locations_2` t2 ON t1.unique_id = t2.unique_id
INNER JOIN `LinkNYC Kiosk Status (Historical)_linknyc_kiosk_locations_1` t3 ON t1.site_id = t3.site_id
INNER JOIN `node_4` t4 ON t1.ppt_id = t4.ppt_id
INNER JOIN `LinkNYC Kiosk Status (Historical)_linknyc_kiosk_status_history_1` t5 ON t2.latitude = t5.latitude AND t2.longitude = t5.longitude
INNER JOIN `LinkNYC Kiosk Status (Historical)_linknyc_kiosk_locations` t6 ON t2.address = t6.address GROUP BY t2.phone_status_date, t2.latitude, t2.longitude, t2.address, t5.latitude, t5.longitude, t6.address

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    t1.ppt_id,
    t1.unique_id,
    t1.site_id,
    t2.unique_id AS t2_unique_id,
    t2.latitude,
    t2.longitude,
    t2.address,
    t3.site_id AS t3_site_id,
    t3.city,
    t4.ppt_id AS t4_ppt_id,
    t4.tablet_status,
    t5.latitude AS t5_latitude,
    t5.longitude AS t5_longitude,
    t5.wifi_status_date,
    t6.address AS t6_address,
    t6.corner,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t3.city ORDER BY t5.wifi_status_date DESC) AS rank,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t4.tablet_status ORDER BY t5.wifi_status_date) AS dense_rank
  FROM `LinkNYC Kiosk Status (Historical)_linknyc_kiosk_status_history` t1
  INNER JOIN `LinkNYC Kiosk Status (Historical)_linknyc_kiosk_locations_2` t2 ON t1.unique_id = t2.unique_id
  INNER JOIN `LinkNYC Kiosk Status (Historical)_linknyc_kiosk_locations_1` t3 ON t1.site_id = t3.site_id
  INNER JOIN `node_4` t4 ON t1.ppt_id = t4.ppt_id
  INNER JOIN `LinkNYC Kiosk Status (Historical)_linknyc_kiosk_status_history_1` t5 ON t2.latitude = t5.latitude AND t2.longitude = t5.longitude
  INNER JOIN `LinkNYC Kiosk Status (Historical)_linknyc_kiosk_locations` t6 ON t2.address = t6.address
)
SELECT 
  ppt_id,
  site_id,

  SELECT t1.bin__, t3.bin__, t1.total_est_fee, t1.owner_type, t3.job_status, t5.latest_action_date,
         CASE
           WHEN t1.total_est_fee > 1000 THEN 'high'
           WHEN t1.total_est_fee > 100 THEN 'medium'
           ELSE 'low'
         END AS category
  FROM `node_1` t1
  INNER JOIN `DOB Sign Application Filings_sign_application_records` t2 ON t1.job__ = t2.job__
  INNER JOIN `node_3` t3 ON t1.bin__ = t3.bin__

  INNER JOIN `DOB Sign Application Filings_sign_application_details` t5 ON t4.owner_s__phone__ = t5.owner_s__phone__
  WHERE t3.job_status IS NOT NULL
)

       COUNT(*) AS count,

    t5.facilitytype,
    t6.averagepublichealthhazardiolationrate,

      WHEN t6.averagepublichealthhazardiolationrate > 10 THEN 'High Risk'
      WHEN t6.averagepublichealthhazardiolationrate > 5 THEN 'Medium Risk'
      ELSE 'Low Risk'
    END AS category
  FROM `DOHMH Childcare Center Inspections_childcare_center_inspections` t1
  INNER JOIN `DOHMH Childcare Center Inspections_childcare_inspection_records` t2 ON t1.dc_id = t2.dc_id
  INNER JOIN `node_3` t3 ON t1.phone = t3.phone
  INNER JOIN `DOHMH Childcare Center Inspections_childcare_inspection_records_1` t4 ON t1.centername = t4.centername
  INNER JOIN `DOHMH Childcare Center Inspections_childcare_center_inspections_1` t5 ON t2.legalname = t5.legalname
  INNER JOIN `DOHMH Childcare Center Inspections_childcare_inspection_results` t6 ON t2.bin = t6.bin
  WHERE t4.inspectiondate IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  programtype,
  facilitytype,
  category,
  COUNT(*) AS count,
  AVG(averagepublichealthhazardiolationrate) AS avg_value,
  SUM(averagepublichealthhazardiolationrate) AS total_value,
  MAX(averagepublichealthhazardiolationrate) AS max_value
FROM categorized_data
GROUP BY 
  programtype,
  facilitytype,
  category

SELECT t3.programtype, t4.inspectiondate, SUM(t4.violationratepercent) AS total, AVG(t4.violationratepercent) AS average, COUNT(*) AS count FROM `DOHMH Childcare Center Inspections_childcare_center_inspections` t1
INNER JOIN `DOHMH Childcare Center Inspections_childcare_inspection_records` t2 ON t1.dc_id = t2.dc_id
INNER JOIN `node_3` t3 ON t1.phone = t3.phone
INNER JOIN `DOHMH Childcare Center Inspections_childcare_inspection_records_1` t4 ON t1.centername = t4.centername
INNER JOIN `DOHMH Childcare Center Inspections_childcare_center_inspections_1` t5 ON t2.legalname = t5.legalname
INNER JOIN `DOHMH Childcare Center Inspections_childcare_inspection_results` t6 ON t2.bin = t6.bin GROUP BY t3.programtype, t4.inspectiondate

WITH base_data AS (
  SELECT 
    t1.centername,
    t1.phone,
    t1.inspectionsummaryresult,
    t3.phone AS t3_phone,
    t3.programtype,
    t4.centername AS t4_centername,
    t4.violationratepercent,
    t5.totaleducationalworkers,
    t6.averagepublichealthhazardiolationrate
  FROM `DOHMH Childcare Center Inspections_childcare_center_inspections` t1
  INNER JOIN `DOHMH Childcare Center Inspections_childcare_inspection_records` t2 ON t1.dc_id = t2.dc_id
  INNER JOIN `node_3` t3 ON t1.phone = t3.phone
  INNER JOIN `DOHMH Childcare Center Inspections_childcare_inspection_records_1` t4 ON t1.centername = t4.centername
  INNER JOIN `DOHMH Childcare Center Inspections_childcare_center_inspections_1` t5 ON t2.legalname = t5.legalname
  INNER JOIN `DOHMH Childcare Center Inspections_childcare_inspection_results` t6 ON t2.bin = t6.bin 
  WHERE t4.inspectiondate >= '2020-01-01'
),
aggregated AS (
  SELECT 
    centername,
    phone,
    inspectionsummaryresult,
    programtype,
    t4_centername,
    SUM(violationratepercent) AS total,
    COUNT(*) AS count,
    AVG(violationratepercent) AS average
  FROM base_data
  GROUP BY centername, phone, inspectionsummaryresult, programtype, t4_centername
)
SELECT 
  centername,
  phone,
  inspectionsummaryresult,
  programtype,
  t4_centername,
  total,
  count,
  average
FROM aggregated
WHERE average > 0
ORDER BY total DESC
LIMIT 100

INNER JOIN `DOHMH Childcare Center Inspections_childcare_inspection_records` t2 ON t1.dc_id = t2.dc_id
INNER JOIN `node_3` t3 ON t1.phone = t3.phone

INNER JOIN `DOHMH Childcare Center Inspections_childcare_center_inspections_1` t5 ON t2.legalname = t5.legalname
INNER JOIN `DOHMH Childcare Center Inspections_childcare_inspection_results` t6 ON t2.bin = t6.bin GROUP BY t1.centername, t1.phone, t3.phone, t4.centername, t3.publichealthhazardviolationrate

WITH base_data AS (
  SELECT 
    t2.bin,
    t2.legalname,
    t2.childcaretype,
    t3.programtype,
    t4.inspectiondate,
    t5.legalname AS t5_legalname,
    t5.facilitytype,
    t6.bin AS t6_bin,
    t6.averagepublichealthhazardiolationrate
  FROM `DOHMH Childcare Center Inspections_childcare_center_inspections` t1
  INNER JOIN `DOHMH Childcare Center Inspections_childcare_inspection_records` t2 ON t1.dc_id = t2.dc_id
  INNER JOIN `node_3` t3 ON t1.phone = t3.phone
  INNER JOIN `DOHMH Childcare Center Inspections_childcare_inspection_records_1` t4 ON t1.centername = t4.centername
  INNER JOIN `DOHMH Childcare Center Inspections_childcare_center_inspections_1` t5 ON t2.legalname = t5.legalname
  INNER JOIN `DOHMH Childcare Center Inspections_childcare_inspection_results` t6 ON t2.bin = t6.bin
  WHERE t4.inspectiondate >= '2020-01-01'
)
SELECT 
  bin,
  legalname,
  childcaretype,
  programtype,
  facilitytype,
  t5_legalname,
  t6_bin,
  inspectiondate,
  COUNT(*) as record_count,
  SUM(averagepublichealthhazardiolationrate) as total_amount,
  AVG(averagepublichealthhazardiolationrate) as avg_amount,
  MAX(averagepublichealthhazardiolationrate) as max_amount,
  MIN(averagepublichealthhazardiolationrate) as min_amount

  programtype,
  facilitytype,

  inspectiondate
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5

SELECT t2.bin, t2.legalname, t5.legalname, t6.bin, SUM(t4.violationratepercent) AS total_dimension1, AVG(t3.publichealthhazardviolationrate) AS average_dimension2 FROM `DOHMH Childcare Center Inspections_childcare_center_inspections` t1
INNER JOIN `DOHMH Childcare Center Inspections_childcare_inspection_records` t2 ON t1.dc_id = t2.dc_id

INNER JOIN `DOHMH Childcare Center Inspections_childcare_center_inspections_1` t5 ON t2.legalname = t5.legalname
INNER JOIN `DOHMH Childcare Center Inspections_childcare_inspection_results` t6 ON t2.bin = t6.bin) SELECT legalname, centername, bin, programtype, inspectiondate, totaleducationalworkers, averagepublichealthhazardiolationrate, rank, dense_rank FROM ranked WHERE rank <= 5

INNER JOIN `NYC Clean Heat Dataset (Historical)_nyc_boiler_compliance_data` t2 ON t1.dep_boiler_application = t2.dep_boiler_application

INNER JOIN `NYC Clean Heat Dataset (Historical)_nyc_building_ownership_info` t5 ON t4.borough_block_lot = t5.borough_block_lot) SELECT city_council_district, total_units, borough_block_lot, boiler_capacity_gross_btu, utility, ownership_borough_block_lot, of_res_units, rank, dense_rank FROM ranked WHERE rank <= 5

INNER JOIN `NYC Clean Heat Dataset (Historical)_nyc_building_heating_data` t4 ON t2.owner = t4.owner

INNER JOIN `NYC Clean Heat Dataset (Historical)_nyc_building_heating_data` t4 ON t2.owner = t4.owner

INNER JOIN `NYC Clean Heat Dataset (Historical)_nyc_boiler_compliance_data` t2 ON t1.dep_boiler_application = t2.dep_boiler_application

INNER JOIN `NYC Clean Heat Dataset (Historical)_nyc_building_ownership_info` t5 ON t4.borough_block_lot = t5.borough_block_lot WHERE t4.boiler_capacity_gross_btu IS NOT NULL) SELECT t2_owner, t4_owner, t4_borough_block_lot, t5_borough_block_lot, total_units, of_res_units, category, COUNT(*) as count, AVG(boiler_capacity_gross_btu) as avg_value, SUM(boiler_capacity_gross_btu) as total_value, MAX(boiler_capacity_gross_btu) as max_value FROM categorized_data GROUP BY t2_owner, t4_owner, t4_borough_block_lot, t5_borough_block_lot, total_units, of_res_units, category

INNER JOIN `NYC Clean Heat Dataset (Historical)_nyc_boiler_compliance_data` t2 ON t1.dep_boiler_application = t2.dep_boiler_application

INNER JOIN `2018 - 2019 School Locations_school_location_details_2` t3 ON t1.location_code = t3.location_code
INNER JOIN `2018 - 2019 School Locations_school_location_details` t4 ON t1.location_name = t4.location_name
INNER JOIN `2018 - 2019 School Locations_school_location_details_1` t5 ON t2.principal_name = t5.principal_name WHERE t5.fiscal_year = 2019) SELECT location_name, location_code, t3_location_code, t4_location_name, fiscal_year, category, COUNT(*) as count, AVG(beds_number) as avg_value, SUM(beds_number) as total_value, MAX(beds_number) as max_value FROM categorized_data GROUP BY location_name, location_code, t3_location_code, t4_location_name, fiscal_year, category

    t5.fiscal_year

  INNER JOIN `2018 - 2019 School Locations_school_location_details_3` t2 ON t1.system_code = t2.system_code
  INNER JOIN `2018 - 2019 School Locations_school_location_details_2` t3 ON t1.location_code = t3.location_code
  INNER JOIN `2018 - 2019 School Locations_school_location_details` t4 ON t1.location_name = t4.location_name
  INNER JOIN `2018 - 2019 School Locations_school_location_details_1` t5 ON t2.principal_name = t5.principal_name

),

    school_support_team_name,

    fiscal_year

  fiscal_year,

INNER JOIN `DOF： Condominium Comparable Rental Income – Manhattan – FY 2011 2012_manhattan_condo_rental_income` t2 ON t1.manhattan_condominiums_comparable_properties_condo_section = t2.manhattan_condominiums_comparable_properties_condo_section

WITH base_data AS (
  SELECT 
    t2.latitude AS t2_latitude,
    t2.longitude AS t2_longitude,
    t5.latitude AS t5_latitude,
    t5.longitude AS t5_longitude,
    t3.manhattan_condominiums_comparable_properties_neighborhood,
    t4.manhattan_condominiums_comparable_properties_total_units,
    t5.manhattan_condominiums_comparable_properties_gross_income_per_sqft,
    t2.manhattan_condominiums_comparable_properties_net_operating_income
  FROM `DOF： Condominium Comparable Rental Income – Manhattan – FY 2011 2012_manhattan_condo_rental_comparables_1` t1
  INNER JOIN `DOF： Condominium Comparable Rental Income – Manhattan – FY 2011 2012_manhattan_condo_rental_income` t2 
    ON t1.manhattan_condominiums_comparable_properties_condo_section = t2.manhattan_condominiums_comparable_properties_condo_section
  INNER JOIN `DOF： Condominium Comparable Rental Income – Manhattan – FY 2011 2012_manhattan_condo_rental_comparables` t3 
    ON t1.manhattan_condominiums_comparable_properties_address = t3.manhattan_condominiums_comparable_properties_address
  INNER JOIN `node_4` t4 
    ON t1.manhattan_condominiums_comparable_properties_boro_block_lot = t4.manhattan_condominiums_comparable_properties_boro_block_lot
  INNER JOIN `DOF： Condominium Comparable Rental Income – Manhattan – FY 2011 2012_manhattan_condo_rental_income_1` t5 
    ON t2.latitude = t5.latitude AND t2.longitude = t5.longitude 
  WHERE t5.manhattan_condominiums_comparable_properties_gross_income_per_sqft IS NOT NULL
), 
aggregated AS (
  SELECT 
    manhattan_condominiums_comparable_properties_neighborhood,
    manhattan_condominiums_comparable_properties_total_units,
    t2_latitude,
    t2_longitude,
    t5_latitude,
    t5_longitude,
    SUM(manhattan_condominiums_comparable_properties_gross_income_per_sqft) AS total,
    COUNT(*) AS count,
    AVG(manhattan_condominiums_comparable_properties_gross_income_per_sqft) AS average
  FROM base_data 
  GROUP BY 
    manhattan_condominiums_comparable_properties_neighborhood,
    manhattan_condominiums_comparable_properties_total_units,
    t2_latitude,
    t2_longitude,
    t5_latitude,
    t5_longitude
)
SELECT 
  manhattan_condominiums_comparable_properties_neighborhood,
  manhattan_condominiums_comparable_properties_total_units,
  t2_latitude,
  t2_longitude,
  t5_latitude,
  t5_longitude,
  total,
  count,
  average
FROM aggregated 
WHERE count >= 1 
ORDER BY total DESC 
LIMIT 100

WITH ranked_data AS (
  SELECT 
    t2.vehicle_year,
    t2.vehicle_color,
    t3.violation_precinct,
    t3.days_parking_in_effect,
    t4.issuing_agency,
    t4.plate_type,
    t5.issue_date,
    t5.violation_description,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY t3.violation_precinct 
      ORDER BY t2.vehicle_year DESC
    ) AS row_num
  FROM `Parking Violations Issued - Fiscal Year 2017_parking_violations_2017` t1
  INNER JOIN `Parking Violations Issued - Fiscal Year 2017_parking_violations_2017_1` t2 ON t1.summons_number = t2.summons_number
  INNER JOIN `Parking Violations Issued - Fiscal Year 2017_parking_violation_records_2017` t3 ON t1.plate_id = t3.plate_id
  INNER JOIN `Parking Violations Issued - Fiscal Year 2017_parking_violations_fy2017` t4 ON t1.street_name = t4.street_name
  INNER JOIN `Parking Violations Issued - Fiscal Year 2017_parking_violations_2017_2` t5 ON t1.issuer_code = t5.issuer_code
  WHERE t5.issue_date >= '2017-01-01'
)
SELECT 
  vehicle_year,
  vehicle_color,
  violation_precinct,
  days_parking_in_effect,
  issuing_agency,
  plate_type,
  issue_date,
  violation_description
FROM ranked_data
WHERE row_num <= 3

SELECT t5.issue_date, t4.issuing_agency, SUM(t3.violation_precinct) AS total, AVG(t3.violation_precinct) AS average, COUNT(*) AS count FROM `Parking Violations Issued - Fiscal Year 2017_parking_violations_2017` t1
INNER JOIN `Parking Violations Issued - Fiscal Year 2017_parking_violations_2017_1` t2 ON t1.summons_number = t2.summons_number
INNER JOIN `Parking Violations Issued - Fiscal Year 2017_parking_violation_records_2017` t3 ON t1.plate_id = t3.plate_id
INNER JOIN `Parking Violations Issued - Fiscal Year 2017_parking_violations_fy2017` t4 ON t1.street_name = t4.street_name
INNER JOIN `Parking Violations Issued - Fiscal Year 2017_parking_violations_2017_2` t5 ON t1.issuer_code = t5.issuer_code GROUP BY t5.issue_date, t4.issuing_agency

WITH categorized_data AS (SELECT t1.summons_number, t2.summons_number, t1.issuer_code, t1.plate_id, t3.plate_id, t1.street_name, t4.street_name, t5.issuer_code, t2.vehicle_year, t3.violation_precinct, t4.law_section, t5.violation_description, CASE WHEN t2.vehicle_year > 2015 THEN 'newer_vehicles' WHEN t2.vehicle_year > 2010 THEN 'mid_age_vehicles' ELSE 'older_vehicles' END as category FROM `Parking Violations Issued - Fiscal Year 2017_parking_violations_2017` t1
INNER JOIN `Parking Violations Issued - Fiscal Year 2017_parking_violations_2017_1` t2 ON t1.summons_number = t2.summons_number
INNER JOIN `Parking Violations Issued - Fiscal Year 2017_parking_violation_records_2017` t3 ON t1.plate_id = t3.plate_id
INNER JOIN `Parking Violations Issued - Fiscal Year 2017_parking_violations_fy2017` t4 ON t1.street_name = t4.street_name
INNER JOIN `Parking Violations Issued - Fiscal Year 2017_parking_violations_2017_2` t5 ON t1.issuer_code = t5.issuer_code WHERE t2.vehicle_year IS NOT NULL) SELECT violation_precinct, street_name, law_section, violation_description, category, COUNT(*) as count, AVG(vehicle_year) as avg_value, SUM(vehicle_year) as total_value, MAX(vehicle_year) as max_value FROM categorized_data GROUP BY violation_precinct, street_name, law_section, violation_description, category

SELECT t1.issuer_code, SUM(t2.vehicle_year) AS total_vehicle_years FROM `Parking Violations Issued - Fiscal Year 2017_parking_violations_2017` t1
INNER JOIN `Parking Violations Issued - Fiscal Year 2017_parking_violations_2017_1` t2 ON t1.summons_number = t2.summons_number
INNER JOIN `Parking Violations Issued - Fiscal Year 2017_parking_violation_records_2017` t3 ON t1.plate_id = t3.plate_id
INNER JOIN `Parking Violations Issued - Fiscal Year 2017_parking_violations_fy2017` t4 ON t1.street_name = t4.street_name
INNER JOIN `Parking Violations Issued - Fiscal Year 2017_parking_violations_2017_2` t5 ON t1.issuer_code = t5.issuer_code GROUP BY t1.issuer_code

WITH categorized_data AS (
  SELECT 
    t3.typecatego, 
    t3.acres, 
    t4.subcategor, 
    t4.mapped, 
    t5.councildis, 
    t5.acquisitio, 
    t6.nys_assemb, 
    t6.permit,
    CASE 
      WHEN t3.acres > 10 THEN 'large' 
      WHEN t3.acres > 1 THEN 'medium' 
      ELSE 'small' 
    END as category 
  FROM `OpenData_ParksProperties_park_property_details_1` t1
  INNER JOIN `OpenData_ParksProperties_park_properties_details` t2 ON t1.gispropnum = t2.gispropnum
  INNER JOIN `OpenData_ParksProperties_nyc_park_properties` t3 ON t1.objectid = t3.objectid
  INNER JOIN `OpenData_ParksProperties_parks_property_details` t4 ON t1.omppropid = t4.omppropid
  INNER JOIN `OpenData_ParksProperties_park_property_details` t5 ON t2.gisobjid = t5.gisobjid
  INNER JOIN `OpenData_ParksProperties_park_property_permits` t6 ON t2.global_id = t6.global_id 
  WHERE t4.mapped = 'True'
)
SELECT 
  typecatego, 
  subcategor, 
  councildis, 
  permit, 
  category, 
  COUNT(*) as count, 
  AVG(acres) as avg_value, 
  SUM(acres) as total_value, 
  MAX(acres) as max_value 
FROM categorized_data 
GROUP BY 
  typecatego, 
  subcategor, 
  councildis, 
  permit, 
  category

SELECT t3.class, t4.subcategor, SUM(t3.acres) AS total, AVG(t3.acres) AS average, COUNT(*) AS count FROM `OpenData_ParksProperties_park_property_details_1` t1
INNER JOIN `OpenData_ParksProperties_park_properties_details` t2 ON t1.gispropnum = t2.gispropnum
INNER JOIN `OpenData_ParksProperties_nyc_park_properties` t3 ON t1.objectid = t3.objectid
INNER JOIN `OpenData_ParksProperties_parks_property_details` t4 ON t1.omppropid = t4.omppropid
INNER JOIN `OpenData_ParksProperties_park_property_details` t5 ON t2.gisobjid = t5.gisobjid
INNER JOIN `OpenData_ParksProperties_park_property_permits` t6 ON t2.global_id = t6.global_id GROUP BY t3.class, t4.subcategor

WITH base_data AS (SELECT t1.objectid, t1.omppropid, t3.objectid AS t3_objectid, t3.acres, t4.omppropid AS t4_omppropid, t4.subcategor, t5.acquisitio, t6.nys_assemb FROM `OpenData_ParksProperties_park_property_details_1` t1
INNER JOIN `OpenData_ParksProperties_park_properties_details` t2 ON t1.gispropnum = t2.gispropnum
INNER JOIN `OpenData_ParksProperties_nyc_park_properties` t3 ON t1.objectid = t3.objectid
INNER JOIN `OpenData_ParksProperties_parks_property_details` t4 ON t1.omppropid = t4.omppropid
INNER JOIN `OpenData_ParksProperties_park_property_details` t5 ON t2.gisobjid = t5.gisobjid
INNER JOIN `OpenData_ParksProperties_park_property_permits` t6 ON t2.global_id = t6.global_id WHERE t3.acres > 0), aggregated AS (SELECT omppropid, subcategor, nys_assemb, SUM(acres) as total, COUNT(*) as count, AVG(acres) as average FROM base_data GROUP BY omppropid, subcategor, nys_assemb) SELECT omppropid, subcategor, nys_assemb, total, count, average FROM aggregated WHERE total > 0 ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT t1.objectid, t1.omppropid, t4.omppropid, t3.objectid, t3.acres, SUM(t5.acquisitio) AS total_acquisition_value FROM `OpenData_ParksProperties_park_property_details_1` t1
INNER JOIN `OpenData_ParksProperties_park_properties_details` t2 ON t1.gispropnum = t2.gispropnum
INNER JOIN `OpenData_ParksProperties_nyc_park_properties` t3 ON t1.objectid = t3.objectid
INNER JOIN `OpenData_ParksProperties_parks_property_details` t4 ON t1.omppropid = t4.omppropid
INNER JOIN `OpenData_ParksProperties_park_property_details` t5 ON t2.gisobjid = t5.gisobjid
INNER JOIN `OpenData_ParksProperties_park_property_permits` t6 ON t2.global_id = t6.global_id GROUP BY t1.objectid, t1.omppropid, t4.omppropid, t3.objectid, t3.acres

WITH ranked AS (SELECT t6.global_id, t1.objectid, t4.omppropid, t1.omppropid, t2.gispropnum, t5.gisobjid, t3.objectid, t2.global_id, t2.gisobjid, t3.acres, t4.subcategor, t5.acquisitio, t6.nys_assemb, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t4.subcategor ORDER BY t3.acres DESC) as rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t6.nys_assemb ORDER BY t5.acquisitio) as dense_rank FROM `OpenData_ParksProperties_park_property_details_1` t1
INNER JOIN `OpenData_ParksProperties_park_properties_details` t2 ON t1.gispropnum = t2.gispropnum
INNER JOIN `OpenData_ParksProperties_nyc_park_properties` t3 ON t1.objectid = t3.objectid
INNER JOIN `OpenData_ParksProperties_parks_property_details` t4 ON t1.omppropid = t4.omppropid
INNER JOIN `OpenData_ParksProperties_park_property_details` t5 ON t2.gisobjid = t5.gisobjid
INNER JOIN `OpenData_ParksProperties_park_property_permits` t6 ON t2.global_id = t6.global_id) SELECT global_id, omppropid, gispropnum, gisobjid, acres, subcategor, rank, dense_rank FROM ranked WHERE rank <= 5

SELECT t4.subcategor, SUM(t3.acres) AS total_acres FROM `OpenData_ParksProperties_park_property_details_1` t1
INNER JOIN `OpenData_ParksProperties_park_properties_details` t2 ON t1.gispropnum = t2.gispropnum
INNER JOIN `OpenData_ParksProperties_nyc_park_properties` t3 ON t1.objectid = t3.objectid
INNER JOIN `OpenData_ParksProperties_parks_property_details` t4 ON t1.omppropid = t4.omppropid
INNER JOIN `OpenData_ParksProperties_park_property_details` t5 ON t2.gisobjid = t5.gisobjid
INNER JOIN `OpenData_ParksProperties_park_property_permits` t6 ON t2.global_id = t6.global_id GROUP BY t4.subcategor

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    t1.segmentid,
    t1.oft,
    t1.installationdate,
    t2.segmentid AS t2_segmentid,
    t2.tolongitude,
    t2.segmentstatusdescription,
    t4.oft AS t4_oft,
    t4.segmentstatus,
    t5.tolongitude AS t5_tolongitude,
    t5.bctsnum,
    t6.onstreet,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.segmentid ORDER BY t1.installationdate DESC) AS rank,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t6.onstreet ORDER BY t1.installationdate) AS dense_rank
  FROM `Speed Reducer Tracking System (SRTS)_speed_reducer_projects_status` t1
  INNER JOIN `Speed Reducer Tracking System (SRTS)_speed_reducer_requests` t2 ON t1.segmentid = t2.segmentid
  INNER JOIN `Speed Reducer Tracking System (SRTS)_speed_reducer_requests_1` t3 ON t1.lionkey = t3.lionkey
  INNER JOIN `Speed Reducer Tracking System (SRTS)_speed_reducer_requests_2` t4 ON t1.oft = t4.oft
  INNER JOIN `Speed Reducer Tracking System (SRTS)_speed_reducer_locations` t5 ON t2.tolongitude = t5.tolongitude
  INNER JOIN `Speed Reducer Tracking System (SRTS)_speed_reducer_status` t6 ON t3.tolatitude = t6.tolatitude
)
SELECT 
  segmentid,
  oft,
  t2_segmentid,
  tolongitude,
  t4_oft,
  bctsnum,
  onstreet,
  rank,
  dense_rank
FROM ranked
WHERE rank <= 5

SELECT t3.tolatitude, t3.geoboroughname, t4.segmentstatus, t5.bctsnum, t6.onstreet, SUM(t3.numsrproposed) AS total_speed_reducers_proposed FROM `Speed Reducer Tracking System (SRTS)_speed_reducer_projects_status` t1
INNER JOIN `Speed Reducer Tracking System (SRTS)_speed_reducer_requests` t2 ON t1.segmentid = t2.segmentid
INNER JOIN `Speed Reducer Tracking System (SRTS)_speed_reducer_requests_1` t3 ON t1.lionkey = t3.lionkey
INNER JOIN `Speed Reducer Tracking System (SRTS)_speed_reducer_requests_2` t4 ON t1.oft = t4.oft
INNER JOIN `Speed Reducer Tracking System (SRTS)_speed_reducer_locations` t5 ON t2.tolongitude = t5.tolongitude
INNER JOIN `Speed Reducer Tracking System (SRTS)_speed_reducer_status` t6 ON t3.tolatitude = t6.tolatitude GROUP BY t3.tolatitude, t3.geoboroughname, t4.segmentstatus, t5.bctsnum, t6.onstreet

SELECT t2.groupowner, COUNT(t2.segmentid) AS request_count, t4.segmentstatus, t5.bctsnum, t2.tolongitude, t3.tolatitude, t6.trafficdirectiondesc FROM `Speed Reducer Tracking System (SRTS)_speed_reducer_projects_status` t1
INNER JOIN `Speed Reducer Tracking System (SRTS)_speed_reducer_requests` t2 ON t1.segmentid = t2.segmentid
INNER JOIN `Speed Reducer Tracking System (SRTS)_speed_reducer_requests_1` t3 ON t1.lionkey = t3.lionkey
INNER JOIN `Speed Reducer Tracking System (SRTS)_speed_reducer_requests_2` t4 ON t1.oft = t4.oft
INNER JOIN `Speed Reducer Tracking System (SRTS)_speed_reducer_locations` t5 ON t2.tolongitude = t5.tolongitude
INNER JOIN `Speed Reducer Tracking System (SRTS)_speed_reducer_status` t6 ON t3.tolatitude = t6.tolatitude GROUP BY t2.groupowner, t4.segmentstatus, t5.bctsnum, t2.tolongitude, t3.tolatitude, t6.trafficdirectiondesc

SELECT t3.condo_number, t4.bldg_class, SUM(t5.finexmptxbl) AS total, AVG(t5.finexmptxbl) AS average, COUNT(*) AS count FROM `Property Exemption Detail_property_tax_exemptions_2` t1
INNER JOIN `Property Exemption Detail_property_tax_exemptions_1` t2 ON t1.parid = t2.parid
INNER JOIN `Property Exemption Detail_property_exemption_records` t3 ON t1.caseno = t3.caseno
INNER JOIN `Property Exemption Detail_property_tax_exemptions` t4 ON t1.lot = t4.lot
INNER JOIN `Property Exemption Detail_property_tax_exemptions_3` t5 ON t2.exname = t5.exname GROUP BY t3.condo_number, t4.bldg_class

SELECT t1.caseno, t1.lot, t3.caseno AS detail_caseno, t4.lot AS tax_lot, SUM(t3.tenexmptrn) AS total_tenant_exemption_amount, SUM(t4.pyexmptot) AS total_prior_year_exemption, SUM(t5.finexmptxbl) AS total_final_exempt_taxable FROM `Property Exemption Detail_property_tax_exemptions_2` t1
INNER JOIN `Property Exemption Detail_property_tax_exemptions_1` t2 ON t1.parid = t2.parid
INNER JOIN `Property Exemption Detail_property_exemption_records` t3 ON t1.caseno = t3.caseno
INNER JOIN `Property Exemption Detail_property_tax_exemptions` t4 ON t1.lot = t4.lot
INNER JOIN `Property Exemption Detail_property_tax_exemptions_3` t5 ON t2.exname = t5.exname GROUP BY t1.caseno, t1.lot, t3.caseno, t4.lot

SELECT t2.exname AS owner_name, t5.exname AS exemption_owner_name, SUM(t4.pyexmptot) AS total_current_exemption_amount, AVG(t3.condo_number) AS average_condo_number, SUM(t5.finexmptxbl) AS total_final_exempt_taxable, AVG(t2.finexmptot) AS average_final_exemption_total FROM `Property Exemption Detail_property_tax_exemptions_2` t1 INNER JOIN `Property Exemption Detail_property_tax_exemptions_1` t2 ON t1.parid = t2.parid INNER JOIN `Property Exemption Detail_property_exemption_records` t3 ON t1.caseno = t3.caseno INNER JOIN `Property Exemption Detail_property_tax_exemptions` t4 ON t1.lot = t4.lot INNER JOIN `Property Exemption Detail_property_tax_exemptions_3` t5 ON t2.exname = t5.exname GROUP BY t2.exname, t5.exname

SELECT t2.exname, SUM(t3.tenexmptrn) AS total_ten_year_exemption_amount FROM `Property Exemption Detail_property_tax_exemptions_2` t1
INNER JOIN `Property Exemption Detail_property_tax_exemptions_1` t2 ON t1.parid = t2.parid
INNER JOIN `Property Exemption Detail_property_exemption_records` t3 ON t1.caseno = t3.caseno
INNER JOIN `Property Exemption Detail_property_tax_exemptions` t4 ON t1.lot = t4.lot
INNER JOIN `Property Exemption Detail_property_tax_exemptions_3` t5 ON t2.exname = t5.exname GROUP BY t2.exname

WITH ranked_data AS (
  SELECT 
    t3.base_does_business_as,
    t3.fatal_crashes,
    t3.top_vehicle_models_3,
    t5.industry_sector,
    t5.book_ahead_service,
    t5.sector_average_base_safety_violations_per_vehicle,
    t5.fatal_crash_details,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY t3.base_does_business_as 
      ORDER BY t5.sector_average_base_safety_violations_per_vehicle DESC
    ) AS row_num
  FROM `Vision Zero Base Report_vehicle_safety_statistics` t1
  INNER JOIN `Vision Zero Base Report_taxi_base_safety_data` t2 ON t1.license_number = t2.license_number
  INNER JOIN `node_3` t3 ON t1.phone = t3.phone
  INNER JOIN `Vision Zero Base Report_vehicle_safety_and_accessibility_data` t4 ON t2.location = t4.location
  INNER JOIN `Vision Zero Base Report_vehicle_safety_reports` t5 ON t4.latitude = t5.latitude AND t4.longitude = t5.longitude
  WHERE t5.industry_sector IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  base_does_business_as,
  fatal_crashes,
  top_vehicle_models_3,
  industry_sector,
  book_ahead_service,
  sector_average_base_safety_violations_per_vehicle,
  fatal_crash_details
FROM ranked_data

WITH categorized_data AS (
  SELECT 
    t1.dbn,
    t2.dbn,
    t1.school_name,
    t3.school_name,
    t1.fax_number,
    t4.fax_number,
    t1.phone_number,
    t5.phone_number,
    t2.program_highlights,
    t3.se_services,
    t4.priority01,
    t5.priority02,
    t1.grade_span_max,
    CASE 
      WHEN t1.grade_span_max > 12 THEN 'Very High Grade Span'
      WHEN t1.grade_span_max > 10 THEN 'High Grade Span'
      ELSE 'Standard Grade Span'
    END AS category
  FROM `2016 DOE High School Directory_high_school_directory_2016_1` t1
  INNER JOIN `node_2` t2 ON t1.dbn = t2.dbn
  INNER JOIN `node_3` t3 ON t1.school_name = t3.school_name
  INNER JOIN `2016 DOE High School Directory_high_school_programs_info` t4 ON t1.fax_number = t4.fax_number
  INNER JOIN `2016 DOE High School Directory_high_school_directory_2016` t5 ON t1.phone_number = t5.phone_number
  WHERE t1.grade_span_max IS NOT NULL
)

  dbn,
  school_name,
  phone_number,

  MAX(grade_span_max) AS max_value

  school_name,
  phone_number,

  category

INNER JOIN `DSNY DonateNYC Directory_donation_centers_directory_1` t3 ON t1.latitude = t3.latitude AND t1.longitude = t3.longitude
INNER JOIN `DSNY DonateNYC Directory_donation_center_locations` t4 ON t1.address = t4.address
INNER JOIN `DSNY DonateNYC Directory_donation_sites_directory` t5 ON t2.site = t5.site
INNER JOIN `DSNY DonateNYC Directory_donation_centers_directory_2` t6 ON t3.phone = t6.phone
INNER JOIN `DSNY DonateNYC Directory_donation_centers_directory` t7 ON t4.bin = t7.bin) SELECT latitude, longitude, address, phone, bin, categoriesaccepted, hours, categoriesavailable, rank, dense_rank FROM ranked WHERE rank <= 5

SELECT t5.senate_district, SUM(t5.congressional_district) AS total_congressional_district, t1.address, t3.phone, t4.bin, t6.hours, t7.categoriesavailable FROM `node_1` t1
INNER JOIN `DSNY DonateNYC Directory_donation_sites_directory_1` t2 ON t1.objectid = t2.objectid
INNER JOIN `DSNY DonateNYC Directory_donation_centers_directory_1` t3 ON t1.latitude = t3.latitude AND t1.longitude = t3.longitude
INNER JOIN `DSNY DonateNYC Directory_donation_center_locations` t4 ON t1.address = t4.address
INNER JOIN `DSNY DonateNYC Directory_donation_sites_directory` t5 ON t2.site = t5.site
INNER JOIN `DSNY DonateNYC Directory_donation_centers_directory_2` t6 ON t3.phone = t6.phone
INNER JOIN `DSNY DonateNYC Directory_donation_centers_directory` t7 ON t4.bin = t7.bin WHERE t5.senate_district = 11 GROUP BY t5.senate_district, t1.address, t3.phone, t4.bin, t6.hours, t7.categoriesavailable

SELECT t5.site, SUM(CASE WHEN t5.senate_district = 11.0 THEN t5.congressional_district ELSE 0 END) AS total_cd_in_senate_11, t2.councildist, t3.ntaname, t4.dsny_section, t6.hours, t7.email FROM `node_1` t1 INNER JOIN `DSNY DonateNYC Directory_donation_sites_directory_1` t2 ON t1.objectid = t2.objectid INNER JOIN `DSNY DonateNYC Directory_donation_centers_directory_1` t3 ON t1.latitude = t3.latitude AND t1.longitude = t3.longitude INNER JOIN `DSNY DonateNYC Directory_donation_center_locations` t4 ON t1.address = t4.address INNER JOIN `DSNY DonateNYC Directory_donation_sites_directory` t5 ON t2.site = t5.site INNER JOIN `DSNY DonateNYC Directory_donation_centers_directory_2` t6 ON t3.phone = t6.phone INNER JOIN `DSNY DonateNYC Directory_donation_centers_directory` t7 ON t4.bin = t7.bin GROUP BY t5.site, t2.councildist, t3.ntaname, t4.dsny_section, t6.hours, t7.email

WITH raw_data AS (
  SELECT 
    t1.objectid,
    t1.latitude,
    t1.longitude,
    t1.address,
    t2.objectid AS t2_objectid,
    t2.site,
    t3.latitude AS t3_latitude,
    t3.longitude AS t3_longitude,
    t3.phone,
    t4.bin,
    t4.address AS t4_address,
    t5.site AS t5_site,
    t5.categoriesaccepted,
    t6.phone AS t6_phone,
    t6.hours,
    t7.bin AS t7_bin,
    t7.email,
    t5.senate_district
  FROM `node_1` t1
  INNER JOIN `DSNY DonateNYC Directory_donation_sites_directory_1` t2 ON t1.objectid = t2.objectid
  INNER JOIN `DSNY DonateNYC Directory_donation_centers_directory_1` t3 ON t1.latitude = t3.latitude AND t1.longitude = t3.longitude
  INNER JOIN `DSNY DonateNYC Directory_donation_center_locations` t4 ON t1.address = t4.address
  INNER JOIN `DSNY DonateNYC Directory_donation_sites_directory` t5 ON t2.site = t5.site
  INNER JOIN `DSNY DonateNYC Directory_donation_centers_directory_2` t6 ON t3.phone = t6.phone
  INNER JOIN `DSNY DonateNYC Directory_donation_centers_directory` t7 ON t4.bin = t7.bin
  WHERE t5.categoriesaccepted IS NOT NULL
), filtered AS (
  SELECT 
    objectid,
    latitude,
    longitude,
    address,
    t2_objectid,
    site,
    t3_latitude,
    t3_longitude,
    phone,
    bin,
    t4_address,
    t5_site,
    categoriesaccepted,
    t6_phone,
    hours,
    t7_bin,
    email,
    senate_district
  FROM raw_data
  WHERE hours IS NOT NULL
), aggregated AS (
  SELECT 
    site,
    categoriesaccepted,
    senate_district,
    COUNT(*) AS count,
    SUM(senate_district) AS total
  FROM filtered
  GROUP BY site, categoriesaccepted, senate_district
)
SELECT 
  site,
  categoriesaccepted,
  senate_district,
  count,
  total
FROM aggregated
ORDER BY total DESC
LIMIT 50

SELECT t1.objectid, CASE WHEN t5.categoriesaccepted = 'Clothing/Personal Accessories' THEN 'Clothing Site' ELSE 'Other Site' END AS site_type, COUNT(t7.email) AS contact_count, t3.latitude, t3.longitude, t5.site, t6.phone, t7.bin, t4.address FROM `node_1` t1 INNER JOIN `DSNY DonateNYC Directory_donation_sites_directory_1` t2 ON t1.objectid = t2.objectid INNER JOIN `DSNY DonateNYC Directory_donation_centers_directory_1` t3 ON t1.latitude = t3.latitude AND t1.longitude = t3.longitude INNER JOIN `DSNY DonateNYC Directory_donation_center_locations` t4 ON t1.address = t4.address INNER JOIN `DSNY DonateNYC Directory_donation_sites_directory` t5 ON t2.site = t5.site INNER JOIN `DSNY DonateNYC Directory_donation_centers_directory_2` t6 ON t3.phone = t6.phone INNER JOIN `DSNY DonateNYC Directory_donation_centers_directory` t7 ON t4.bin = t7.bin GROUP BY t1.objectid, site_type, t3.latitude, t3.longitude, t5.site, t6.phone, t7.bin, t4.address

WITH categorized_data AS (
  SELECT 
    t3.school_name,
    t3.total_students,
    t4.phone_number,
    t5.website,
    t6.number_programs,
    t6.extracurricular_activities,
    CASE 
      WHEN t3.total_students > 1000 THEN 'large'
      WHEN t3.total_students > 500 THEN 'medium'
      ELSE 'small'
    END as category
  FROM `2014 - 2015 DOE High School Directory_high_school_directory_1` t1
  INNER JOIN `2014 - 2015 DOE High School Directory_high_school_directory` t2 ON t1.dbn = t2.dbn
  INNER JOIN `2014 - 2015 DOE High School Directory_high_school_directory_2014_2015` t3 ON t1.school_name = t3.school_name
  INNER JOIN `2014 - 2015 DOE High School Directory_high_school_directory_2` t4 ON t1.phone_number = t4.phone_number
  INNER JOIN `2014 - 2015 DOE High School Directory_nyc_high_school_directory` t5 ON t1.website = t5.website
  INNER JOIN `2014 - 2015 DOE High School Directory_high_school_directory_3` t6 ON t2.fax_number = t6.fax_number
  WHERE t3.total_students IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  school_name,
  website,
  number_programs,
  category,
  COUNT(*) as count,
  AVG(total_students) as avg_value,
  SUM(total_students) as total_value,
  MAX(total_students) as max_value
FROM categorized_data
GROUP BY 
  school_name,
  website,
  number_programs,
  category

SELECT t3.school_name, t6.number_programs, SUM(t3.total_students) AS total, AVG(t3.total_students) AS average, COUNT(*) AS count FROM `2014 - 2015 DOE High School Directory_high_school_directory_1` t1
INNER JOIN `2014 - 2015 DOE High School Directory_high_school_directory` t2 ON t1.dbn = t2.dbn
INNER JOIN `2014 - 2015 DOE High School Directory_high_school_directory_2014_2015` t3 ON t1.school_name = t3.school_name
INNER JOIN `2014 - 2015 DOE High School Directory_high_school_directory_2` t4 ON t1.phone_number = t4.phone_number
INNER JOIN `2014 - 2015 DOE High School Directory_nyc_high_school_directory` t5 ON t1.website = t5.website
INNER JOIN `2014 - 2015 DOE High School Directory_high_school_directory_3` t6 ON t2.fax_number = t6.fax_number GROUP BY t3.school_name, t6.number_programs

WITH base_data AS (SELECT t1.phone_number, t1.school_name, t1.website, t1.partner_hospital, t3.total_students, t4.partner_other, t5.grade_span_max, t6.number_programs FROM `2014 - 2015 DOE High School Directory_high_school_directory_1` t1
INNER JOIN `2014 - 2015 DOE High School Directory_high_school_directory` t2 ON t1.dbn = t2.dbn
INNER JOIN `2014 - 2015 DOE High School Directory_high_school_directory_2014_2015` t3 ON t1.school_name = t3.school_name
INNER JOIN `2014 - 2015 DOE High School Directory_high_school_directory_2` t4 ON t1.phone_number = t4.phone_number
INNER JOIN `2014 - 2015 DOE High School Directory_nyc_high_school_directory` t5 ON t1.website = t5.website
INNER JOIN `2014 - 2015 DOE High School Directory_high_school_directory_3` t6 ON t2.fax_number = t6.fax_number WHERE t3.total_students IS NOT NULL), aggregated AS (SELECT school_name, website, partner_other, SUM(total_students) as total, COUNT(*) as count, AVG(total_students) as average FROM base_data GROUP BY school_name, website, partner_other) SELECT school_name, website, partner_other, total, count, average FROM aggregated WHERE average > 0 ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT t3.school_name, t1.phone_number, t4.phone_number, t1.website, t5.website, SUM(t3.total_students) AS total_enrollment FROM `2014 - 2015 DOE High School Directory_high_school_directory_1` t1
INNER JOIN `2014 - 2015 DOE High School Directory_high_school_directory` t2 ON t1.dbn = t2.dbn
INNER JOIN `2014 - 2015 DOE High School Directory_high_school_directory_2014_2015` t3 ON t1.school_name = t3.school_name
INNER JOIN `2014 - 2015 DOE High School Directory_high_school_directory_2` t4 ON t1.phone_number = t4.phone_number
INNER JOIN `2014 - 2015 DOE High School Directory_nyc_high_school_directory` t5 ON t1.website = t5.website
INNER JOIN `2014 - 2015 DOE High School Directory_high_school_directory_3` t6 ON t2.fax_number = t6.fax_number GROUP BY t3.school_name, t1.phone_number, t4.phone_number, t1.website, t5.website

WITH base_data AS (SELECT t2.fax_number, t2.priority08, t3.school_name, t4.partner_other, t5.partner_corporate, t6.fax_number, t6.number_programs FROM `2014 - 2015 DOE High School Directory_high_school_directory_1` t1
INNER JOIN `2014 - 2015 DOE High School Directory_high_school_directory` t2 ON t1.dbn = t2.dbn
INNER JOIN `2014 - 2015 DOE High School Directory_high_school_directory_2014_2015` t3 ON t1.school_name = t3.school_name
INNER JOIN `2014 - 2015 DOE High School Directory_high_school_directory_2` t4 ON t1.phone_number = t4.phone_number
INNER JOIN `2014 - 2015 DOE High School Directory_nyc_high_school_directory` t5 ON t1.website = t5.website
INNER JOIN `2014 - 2015 DOE High School Directory_high_school_directory_3` t6 ON t2.fax_number = t6.fax_number WHERE t6.number_programs > 0) SELECT fax_number, school_name, partner_other, COUNT(*) as record_count, SUM(number_programs) as total_amount, AVG(number_programs) as avg_amount, MAX(number_programs) as max_amount, MIN(number_programs) as min_amount FROM base_data GROUP BY fax_number, school_name, partner_other HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1

WITH ranked AS (SELECT t1.dbn, t1.website, t2.dbn AS t2_dbn, t1.phone_number, t1.school_name, t5.website AS t5_website, t4.phone_number AS t4_phone_number, t2.fax_number, t6.fax_number AS t6_fax_number, t3.school_name AS t3_school_name, t3.total_students, t4.psal_sports_coed, t5.online_ap_courses, t6.number_programs, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.dbn ORDER BY t3.total_students DESC) as rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.dbn ORDER BY t6.number_programs) as dense_rank FROM `2014 - 2015 DOE High School Directory_high_school_directory_1` t1
INNER JOIN `2014 - 2015 DOE High School Directory_high_school_directory` t2 ON t1.dbn = t2.dbn
INNER JOIN `2014 - 2015 DOE High School Directory_high_school_directory_2014_2015` t3 ON t1.school_name = t3.school_name
INNER JOIN `2014 - 2015 DOE High School Directory_high_school_directory_2` t4 ON t1.phone_number = t4.phone_number
INNER JOIN `2014 - 2015 DOE High School Directory_nyc_high_school_directory` t5 ON t1.website = t5.website
INNER JOIN `2014 - 2015 DOE High School Directory_high_school_directory_3` t6 ON t2.fax_number = t6.fax_number) SELECT dbn, school_name, total_students, psal_sports_coed, online_ap_courses, number_programs, rank, dense_rank FROM ranked WHERE rank <= 5

SELECT t3.school_name, SUM(t6.number_programs) AS total_programs FROM `2014 - 2015 DOE High School Directory_high_school_directory_1` t1
INNER JOIN `2014 - 2015 DOE High School Directory_high_school_directory` t2 ON t1.dbn = t2.dbn
INNER JOIN `2014 - 2015 DOE High School Directory_high_school_directory_2014_2015` t3 ON t1.school_name = t3.school_name
INNER JOIN `2014 - 2015 DOE High School Directory_high_school_directory_2` t4 ON t1.phone_number = t4.phone_number
INNER JOIN `2014 - 2015 DOE High School Directory_nyc_high_school_directory` t5 ON t1.website = t5.website
INNER JOIN `2014 - 2015 DOE High School Directory_high_school_directory_3` t6 ON t2.fax_number = t6.fax_number GROUP BY t3.school_name

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    t1.entity_name,
    t1.street_address,
    t1.owner_officer_1_last_name,
    t2.entity_name AS t2_entity_name,
    t3.street_address AS t3_street_address,
    t4.owner_officer_1_last_name AS t4_owner_officer_1_last_name,
    t3.owner_officer_3_last_name,
    t4.country,
    t6.individual_title_1,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.entity_name ORDER BY t3.officer_equivalent_2 DESC) AS rank,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t4.owner_officer_1_last_name ORDER BY t6.officer_equivalent_5) AS dense_rank
  FROM `Local Law 44 Disqualified List_disqualified_entities_list_1` t1
  INNER JOIN `Local Law 44 Disqualified List_disqualified_entities_list` t2 ON t1.entity_name = t2.entity_name
  INNER JOIN `Local Law 44 Disqualified List_disqualified_property_owners` t3 ON t1.street_address = t3.street_address
  INNER JOIN `Local Law 44 Disqualified List_disqualified_individuals_list` t4 ON t1.owner_officer_1_last_name = t4.owner_officer_1_last_name
  INNER JOIN `Local Law 44 Disqualified List_disqualified_contractors_list` t5 ON t2.owner_officer_1_first_name = t5.owner_officer_1_first_name
  INNER JOIN `node_6` t6 ON t5.postcode = t6.postcode
) 
SELECT 
  entity_name,
  street_address,
  owner_officer_1_last_name,
  t2_entity_name,
  t3_street_address,
  t4_owner_officer_1_last_name,
  owner_officer_3_last_name,
  country,
  individual_title_1,
  rank,
  dense_rank
FROM ranked 
WHERE rank <= 5

SELECT t5.entity_role, COUNT(t5.officer_equivalent_1) AS disqualified_entity_count, t2.owner_officer_1_first_name, t5.owner_officer_1_first_name, t6.postcode, t3.owner_officer_3_last_name, t4.individual_role_5, t6.individual_title_5 FROM `Local Law 44 Disqualified List_disqualified_entities_list_1` t1
INNER JOIN `Local Law 44 Disqualified List_disqualified_entities_list` t2 ON t1.entity_name = t2.entity_name
INNER JOIN `Local Law 44 Disqualified List_disqualified_property_owners` t3 ON t1.street_address = t3.street_address
INNER JOIN `Local Law 44 Disqualified List_disqualified_individuals_list` t4 ON t1.owner_officer_1_last_name = t4.owner_officer_1_last_name
INNER JOIN `Local Law 44 Disqualified List_disqualified_contractors_list` t5 ON t2.owner_officer_1_first_name = t5.owner_officer_1_first_name
INNER JOIN `node_6` t6 ON t5.postcode = t6.postcode GROUP BY t5.entity_role, t2.owner_officer_1_first_name, t5.owner_officer_1_first_name, t6.postcode, t3.owner_officer_3_last_name, t4.individual_role_5, t6.individual_title_5

WITH ranked_data AS (
  SELECT 
    t3.nys_senate,
    t3.commission,
    t5.councildis,
    t5.propname,
    t5.gstype,
    t5.organizati,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t3.nys_senate ORDER BY t5.councildis DESC) AS row_num
  FROM `ARCHIVE - Greenstreets_greenstreets_site_information` t1
  INNER JOIN `node_2` t2 ON t1.objectid = t2.objectid
  INNER JOIN `ARCHIVE - Greenstreets_greenstreets_senate_commissions` t3 ON t1.system = t3.system
  INNER JOIN `ARCHIVE - Greenstreets_greenstreets_park_locations` t4 ON t2.omppropid = t4.omppropid
  INNER JOIN `ARCHIVE - Greenstreets_greenstreets_locations_nyc` t5 ON t4.global_id = t5.global_id
  WHERE t5.gstype = 'Greenstreet'
)
SELECT 
  nys_senate,
  commission,
  councildis,
  propname,
  gstype,
  organizati
FROM ranked_data
WHERE row_num <= 5

SELECT t1.department, t1.system, t3.system, SUM(t1.communityb) AS total_communityb FROM `ARCHIVE - Greenstreets_greenstreets_site_information` t1 INNER JOIN `node_2` t2 ON t1.objectid = t2.objectid INNER JOIN `ARCHIVE - Greenstreets_greenstreets_senate_commissions` t3 ON t1.system = t3.system INNER JOIN `ARCHIVE - Greenstreets_greenstreets_park_locations` t4 ON t2.omppropid = t4.omppropid INNER JOIN `ARCHIVE - Greenstreets_greenstreets_locations_nyc` t5 ON t4.global_id = t5.global_id GROUP BY t1.department, t1.system, t3.system

WITH base_data AS (
  SELECT t1.objectid, t2.objectid AS t2_objectid, t1.system, t3.system AS t3_system, t1.communityb, t2.acres, t3.nys_senate, t5.councildis
  FROM `ARCHIVE - Greenstreets_greenstreets_site_information` t1
  INNER JOIN `node_2` t2 ON t1.objectid = t2.objectid
  INNER JOIN `ARCHIVE - Greenstreets_greenstreets_senate_commissions` t3 ON t1.system = t3.system
  INNER JOIN `ARCHIVE - Greenstreets_greenstreets_park_locations` t4 ON t2.omppropid = t4.omppropid
  INNER JOIN `ARCHIVE - Greenstreets_greenstreets_locations_nyc` t5 ON t4.global_id = t5.global_id
  WHERE t2.acres IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT nys_senate, councildis, communityb, COUNT(*) AS record_count,
       SUM(acres) AS total_amount,
       AVG(acres) AS avg_amount,
       MAX(acres) AS max_amount,
       MIN(acres) AS min_amount
FROM base_data
GROUP BY nys_senate, councildis, communityb
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5

SELECT t1.system, SUM(t2.acres) AS total_acres FROM `ARCHIVE - Greenstreets_greenstreets_site_information` t1
INNER JOIN `node_2` t2 ON t1.objectid = t2.objectid
INNER JOIN `ARCHIVE - Greenstreets_greenstreets_senate_commissions` t3 ON t1.system = t3.system
INNER JOIN `ARCHIVE - Greenstreets_greenstreets_park_locations` t4 ON t2.omppropid = t4.omppropid
INNER JOIN `ARCHIVE - Greenstreets_greenstreets_locations_nyc` t5 ON t4.global_id = t5.global_id GROUP BY t1.system

WITH ranked AS (
SELECT t3.nys_senate, t3.commission, t4.global_id, t4.descriptio, t4.nys_assemb, t5.global_id, t5.councildis, t5.gstype,
       RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t3.nys_senate ORDER BY t5.councildis DESC) as rank,
       DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t4.nys_assemb ORDER BY t5.councildis) as dense_rank
FROM `ARCHIVE - Greenstreets_greenstreets_site_information` t1
INNER JOIN `node_2` t2 ON t1.objectid = t2.objectid
INNER JOIN `ARCHIVE - Greenstreets_greenstreets_senate_commissions` t3 ON t1.system = t3.system
INNER JOIN `ARCHIVE - Greenstreets_greenstreets_park_locations` t4 ON t2.omppropid = t4.omppropid
INNER JOIN `ARCHIVE - Greenstreets_greenstreets_locations_nyc` t5 ON t4.global_id = t5.global_id)
SELECT nys_senate, commission, global_id, descriptio, nys_assemb, councildis, gstype, rank, dense_rank
FROM ranked
WHERE rank <= 5

WITH ranked_data AS (
  SELECT 
    t1.system AS t1_system,
    t3.system AS t3_system,
    t4.global_id AS t4_global_id,
    t5.global_id AS t5_global_id,
    t3.nys_senate,
    t5.councildis,
    t4.descriptio,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t3.system ORDER BY t4.shape_star DESC) AS row_num
  FROM `ARCHIVE - Greenstreets_greenstreets_site_information` t1
  INNER JOIN `node_2` t2 ON t1.objectid = t2.objectid
  INNER JOIN `ARCHIVE - Greenstreets_greenstreets_senate_commissions` t3 ON t1.system = t3.system
  INNER JOIN `ARCHIVE - Greenstreets_greenstreets_park_locations` t4 ON t2.omppropid = t4.omppropid
  INNER JOIN `ARCHIVE - Greenstreets_greenstreets_locations_nyc` t5 ON t4.global_id = t5.global_id
  WHERE t4.descriptio IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  t1_system,
  t3_system,
  t4_global_id,
  t5_global_id,
  nys_senate,
  councildis,
  descriptio
FROM ranked_data
WHERE row_num <= 3

SELECT t1.system, SUM(t4.shape_star) AS total_shape_star, t3.nys_senate, t5.councildis FROM `ARCHIVE - Greenstreets_greenstreets_site_information` t1
INNER JOIN `node_2` t2 ON t1.objectid = t2.objectid
INNER JOIN `ARCHIVE - Greenstreets_greenstreets_senate_commissions` t3 ON t1.system = t3.system
INNER JOIN `ARCHIVE - Greenstreets_greenstreets_park_locations` t4 ON t2.omppropid = t4.omppropid
INNER JOIN `ARCHIVE - Greenstreets_greenstreets_locations_nyc` t5 ON t4.global_id = t5.global_id GROUP BY t1.system, t3.nys_senate, t5.councildis

SELECT t2.omppropid, COUNT(t2.omppropid) AS site_count, t3.nys_senate, t4.descriptio, t5.gstype FROM `ARCHIVE - Greenstreets_greenstreets_site_information` t1
INNER JOIN `node_2` t2 ON t1.objectid = t2.objectid
INNER JOIN `ARCHIVE - Greenstreets_greenstreets_senate_commissions` t3 ON t1.system = t3.system
INNER JOIN `ARCHIVE - Greenstreets_greenstreets_park_locations` t4 ON t2.omppropid = t4.omppropid
INNER JOIN `ARCHIVE - Greenstreets_greenstreets_locations_nyc` t5 ON t4.global_id = t5.global_id GROUP BY t2.omppropid, t3.nys_senate, t4.descriptio, t5.gstype

sql:
WITH ranked_data AS (

  INNER JOIN `DOF： Condominium comparable rental income – Manhattan - FY 2010 2011_manhattan_condo_rental_income_1` t3 
    ON t1.manhattan_condominium_property_address = t3.manhattan_condominium_property_address
  INNER JOIN `DOF： Condominium comparable rental income – Manhattan - FY 2010 2011_manhattan_condo_rental_income` t4 
    ON t1.manhattan_condominium_property_boro_block_lot = t4.manhattan_condominium_property_boro_block_lot
  INNER JOIN `DOF： Condominium comparable rental income – Manhattan - FY 2010 2011_manhattan_condo_rental_comparables_3` t5

  INNER JOIN `DOF： Condominium comparable rental income – Manhattan - FY 2010 2011_manhattan_condo_rental_comparables_1` t6

  WHERE t4.manhattan_condominium_property_full_market_value IS NOT NULL
)

    t5.hearing_status,
    t6.violation_date,
    COALESCE(t6.paid_amount, 0) as paid_amount_clean,
    COALESCE(t4.additional_penalties_or_late_fees, 0) as penalties_clean
  FROM `node_1` t1
  INNER JOIN `OATH Hearings Division Case Status_hearing_case_details` t2 ON t1.ticket_number = t2.ticket_number
  INNER JOIN `node_3` t3 ON t1.respondent_address_house = t3.respondent_address_house
  INNER JOIN `OATH Hearings Division Case Status_oath_hearings_case_details` t4 ON t1.respondent_last_name = t4.respondent_last_name
  INNER JOIN `OATH Hearings Division Case Status_hearing_case_status_summary` t5 ON t2.respondent_address_street_name = t5.respondent_address_street_name
  INNER JOIN `OATH Hearings Division Case Status_oath_case_status_records` t6 ON t5.respondent_first_name = t6.respondent_first_name
  WHERE t6.violation_date IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  respondent_first_name,
  violation_location_borough,
  compliance_status,
  hearing_status,
  violation_date,
  paid_amount_clean,
  penalties_clean,
  COUNT(*) as count,
  SUM(paid_amount_clean) as total
FROM clean_data
GROUP BY 
  respondent_first_name,
  violation_location_borough,
  compliance_status,
  hearing_status,
  violation_date,
  paid_amount_clean,
  penalties_clean

INNER JOIN `OATH Hearings Division Case Status_oath_hearings_case_details` t4 ON t1.respondent_last_name = t4.respondent_last_name

    t3.respondent_address_house,
    t4.respondent_last_name,

    CASE

  FROM `node_1` t1
  INNER JOIN `OATH Hearings Division Case Status_hearing_case_details` t2 ON t1.ticket_number = t2.ticket_number
  INNER JOIN `node_3` t3 ON t1.respondent_address_house = t3.respondent_address_house
  INNER JOIN `OATH Hearings Division Case Status_oath_hearings_case_details` t4 ON t1.respondent_last_name = t4.respondent_last_name
  INNER JOIN `OATH Hearings Division Case Status_hearing_case_status_summary` t5 ON t2.respondent_address_street_name = t5.respondent_address_street_name
  INNER JOIN `OATH Hearings Division Case Status_oath_case_status_records` t6 ON t5.respondent_first_name = t6.respondent_first_name
  WHERE t6.violation_date IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT

  respondent_last_name,

  AVG(paid_amount) as avg_value,

FROM categorized_data
GROUP BY respondent_first_name, respondent_address_house, respondent_last_name, category

SELECT t1.respondent_address_house, SUM(t1.penalty_imposed) AS total_penalty_imposed, t3.decision_location_borough, t4.compliance_status FROM `node_1` t1

INNER JOIN `OATH Hearings Division Case Status_hearing_case_details` t2 ON t1.ticket_number = t2.ticket_number
INNER JOIN `node_3` t3 ON t1.respondent_address_house = t3.respondent_address_house
INNER JOIN `OATH Hearings Division Case Status_oath_hearings_case_details` t4 ON t1.respondent_last_name = t4.respondent_last_name
INNER JOIN `OATH Hearings Division Case Status_hearing_case_status_summary` t5 ON t2.respondent_address_street_name = t5.respondent_address_street_name
INNER JOIN `OATH Hearings Division Case Status_oath_case_status_records` t6 ON t5.respondent_first_name = t6.respondent_first_name

),
aggregated AS (

INNER JOIN `2019 DOE High School Directory_high_school_admissions_data_1` t6 ON t3.code1 = t6.code1 GROUP BY t1.fax_number, t4.fax_number, t1.seats109, t4.grade9swdapplicants1, t5.prgdesc8, t6.prgdesc4

WITH ranked_data AS (SELECT t3.school_name, t3.attendance_rate, t3.academicopportunities4, t4.code1, t4.seats109, t4.method4, t5.phone_number, t5.program1, t5.pct_stu_safe, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t3.school_name ORDER BY t3.attendance_rate DESC) as row_num FROM `2021 DOE High School Directory_high_school_information` t1
INNER JOIN `2021 DOE High School Directory_high_school_admissions_data` t2 ON t1.dbn = t2.dbn
INNER JOIN `2021 DOE High School Directory_high_school_admissions_data_1` t3 ON t1.school_name = t3.school_name
INNER JOIN `2021 DOE High School Directory_high_school_admissions_data_2` t4 ON t1.code1 = t4.code1
INNER JOIN `2021 DOE High School Directory_high_school_programs_info` t5 ON t2.phone_number = t5.phone_number WHERE t3.attendance_rate IS NOT NULL) SELECT school_name, attendance_rate, academicopportunities4, code1, seats109, method4, phone_number, program1, pct_stu_safe FROM ranked_data WHERE row_num <= 5

WITH categorized_data AS (
  SELECT 
    t1.school_name, 
    t4.code1, 
    t1.code1, 
    t3.school_name AS t3_school_name, 
    t3.attendance_rate, 
    t4.seats109, 
    t5.pct_stu_safe,
    CASE 
      WHEN t3.attendance_rate > 0.9 THEN 'High Attendance'
      WHEN t3.attendance_rate > 0.8 THEN 'Medium Attendance'
      ELSE 'Low Attendance'
    END as category
  FROM `2021 DOE High School Directory_high_school_information` t1
  INNER JOIN `2021 DOE High School Directory_high_school_admissions_data` t2 ON t1.dbn = t2.dbn
  INNER JOIN `2021 DOE High School Directory_high_school_admissions_data_1` t3 ON t1.school_name = t3.school_name
  INNER JOIN `2021 DOE High School Directory_high_school_admissions_data_2` t4 ON t1.code1 = t4.code1
  INNER JOIN `2021 DOE High School Directory_high_school_programs_info` t5 ON t2.phone_number = t5.phone_number
  WHERE t3.attendance_rate IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  school_name, 
  code1, 
  t3_school_name, 
  category, 
  COUNT(*) as count, 
  AVG(attendance_rate) as avg_value, 
  SUM(attendance_rate) as total_value, 
  MAX(attendance_rate) as max_value
FROM categorized_data
GROUP BY school_name, code1, t3_school_name, category

INNER JOIN `2021 DOE High School Directory_high_school_admissions_data` t2 ON t1.dbn = t2.dbn
INNER JOIN `2021 DOE High School Directory_high_school_admissions_data_1` t3 ON t1.school_name = t3.school_name
INNER JOIN `2021 DOE High School Directory_high_school_admissions_data_2` t4 ON t1.code1 = t4.code1
INNER JOIN `2021 DOE High School Directory_high_school_programs_info` t5 ON t2.phone_number = t5.phone_number GROUP BY t1.school_name, t1.code1, t3.school_name, t4.code1

INNER JOIN `2021 DOE High School Directory_high_school_admissions_data` t2 ON t1.dbn = t2.dbn
INNER JOIN `2021 DOE High School Directory_high_school_admissions_data_1` t3 ON t1.school_name = t3.school_name
INNER JOIN `2021 DOE High School Directory_high_school_admissions_data_2` t4 ON t1.code1 = t4.code1
INNER JOIN `2021 DOE High School Directory_high_school_programs_info` t5 ON t2.phone_number = t5.phone_number WHERE t3.attendance_rate IS NOT NULL) SELECT dbn, t2_dbn, school_name, t3_school_name, code1, t4_code1, phone_number, t5_phone_number, COUNT(*) as record_count, SUM(pct_stu_safe) as total_amount, AVG(pct_stu_safe) as avg_amount, MAX(pct_stu_safe) as max_amount, MIN(pct_stu_safe) as min_amount FROM base_data GROUP BY dbn, t2_dbn, school_name, t3_school_name, code1, t4_code1, phone_number, t5_phone_number HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1

SELECT t1.school_name, SUM(t3.attendance_rate) AS total_attendance_rate FROM `2021 DOE High School Directory_high_school_information` t1
INNER JOIN `2021 DOE High School Directory_high_school_admissions_data` t2 ON t1.dbn = t2.dbn
INNER JOIN `2021 DOE High School Directory_high_school_admissions_data_1` t3 ON t1.school_name = t3.school_name
INNER JOIN `2021 DOE High School Directory_high_school_admissions_data_2` t4 ON t1.code1 = t4.code1
INNER JOIN `2021 DOE High School Directory_high_school_programs_info` t5 ON t2.phone_number = t5.phone_number GROUP BY t1.school_name

       total_units,

SELECT t3.prevailing_wage_status, t5.project_name, SUM(t5.total_units) AS total, AVG(t5.total_units) AS average, COUNT(*) AS count FROM `Affordable Housing Production by Building_affordable_housing_building_data_1` t1
INNER JOIN `Affordable Housing Production by Building_affordable_housing_units_by_building` t2 ON t1.building_id = t2.building_id
INNER JOIN `Affordable Housing Production by Building_affordable_housing_building_data` t3 ON t1.latitude = t3.latitude AND t1.longitude = t3.longitude
INNER JOIN `Affordable Housing Production by Building_affordable_housing_buildings_1` t4 ON t2.house_number = t4.house_number
INNER JOIN `Affordable Housing Production by Building_affordable_housing_buildings` t5 ON t4.project_id = t5.project_id GROUP BY t3.prevailing_wage_status, t5.project_name

  SELECT 
    t1.latitude, 
    t1.longitude, 
    t3.latitude AS t3_latitude, 
    t3.longitude AS t3_longitude, 
    t1.all_counted_units, 
    t3.other_income_units, 
    t5.total_units,
    CASE 
      WHEN t5.total_units > 100 THEN 'large'
      WHEN t5.total_units > 50 THEN 'medium'
      ELSE 'small'
    END AS category
  FROM `Affordable Housing Production by Building_affordable_housing_building_data_1` t1
  INNER JOIN `Affordable Housing Production by Building_affordable_housing_units_by_building` t2 ON t1.building_id = t2.building_id
  INNER JOIN `Affordable Housing Production by Building_affordable_housing_building_data` t3 ON t1.latitude = t3.latitude AND t1.longitude = t3.longitude
  INNER JOIN `Affordable Housing Production by Building_affordable_housing_buildings_1` t4 ON t2.house_number = t4.house_number
  INNER JOIN `Affordable Housing Production by Building_affordable_housing_buildings` t5 ON t4.project_id = t5.project_id
  WHERE t1.all_counted_units IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  t1_latitude AS latitude,
  t1_longitude AS longitude,
  category,
  COUNT(*) AS count,
  AVG(total_units) AS avg_value,
  SUM(total_units) AS total_value,
  MAX(total_units) AS max_value
FROM (
  SELECT 
    latitude AS t1_latitude,
    longitude AS t1_longitude,
    t3_latitude,
    t3_longitude,
    all_counted_units,
    other_income_units,

INNER JOIN `Affordable Housing Production by Building_affordable_housing_buildings_1` t4 ON t2.house_number = t4.house_number
INNER JOIN `Affordable Housing Production by Building_affordable_housing_buildings` t5 ON t4.project_id = t5.project_id GROUP BY t1.project_start_date

INNER JOIN `Affordable Housing Production by Building_affordable_housing_units_by_building` t2 ON t1.building_id = t2.building_id

INNER JOIN `Affordable Housing Production by Building_affordable_housing_units_by_building` t2 ON t1.building_id = t2.building_id
INNER JOIN `Affordable Housing Production by Building_affordable_housing_building_data` t3 ON t1.latitude = t3.latitude AND t1.longitude = t3.longitude
INNER JOIN `Affordable Housing Production by Building_affordable_housing_buildings_1` t4 ON t2.house_number = t4.house_number

INNER JOIN `Affordable Housing Production by Building_affordable_housing_units_by_building` t2 ON t1.building_id = t2.building_id
